steps.title: Culture C. elegans
steps.instruction: Culture C. elegans on Nematode growth media agarose (NGM agar plates) until adulthood and/or until they begin laying eggs onto the E. coli lawn.

steps.title: Prepare Bleaching Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a fresh bleaching solution in a sterile 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube using the following volumes: 250 μl DI Water, 250 μl Bleach, and 500 μl 1M NaOH.

steps.title: Wash and Collect Worms
steps.instruction: Wash worms from the NGM plate using M9+TX solution (22mM KH2PO4, 42mM NA2HPO4, 89mM NaCl, 1mM MgSO4, 0.1% Triton X-100).

substeps.instruction: Add 1mL of M9+TX solution to the plate using a P1000 pipette.
Pipette the solution across the plate multiple times to wash worms off the lawn.
Transfer worms to a new 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge for 10 sec to pellet.

steps.title: Bleach Adult Worms
steps.instruction: Dissolve adult worm bodies while leaving eggs unharmed using the bleaching solution.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant and add the prepared bleaching solution.
Incubate for 2-5 minutes, shaking occasionally. Do not exceed 5 minutes.
Centrifuge for 10-20 sec to pellet and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Wash and Plate Eggs
steps.instruction: Wash the eggs to remove residual bleach and transfer them to a fresh plate.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in M9+TX.
Repeat the centrifugation (10-20 sec) and resuspension in M9+TX two more times (3 washes total).
Centrifuge for 10-20 sec to pellet, then remove 990μl of supernatant, leaving 50-100μl.
Resuspend the pellet in the remaining 50-100μl of M9+TX using a P100.
Transfer eggs to a fresh NGM plate by pipetting droplets outside of the lawn.
Wait 5-10 minutes for the plate to dry.

steps.title: Incubate Eggs
steps.instruction: Store the plate upside-down in a 20°C incubator until eggs hatch and reach young adult (roughly 60hr) or the desired age.

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Worms
steps.instruction: Collect the grown worms and wash them to remove media.

substeps.instruction: Add 1mL of M9+TX to the plate, wash worms off the lawn, and transfer to a new 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube.
Allow worms to settle for 2 min (Note: L4 and below may not pellet and should be discarded with supernatant).
Remove supernatant and resuspend in M9+TX.
Repeat the settling and resuspension steps two more times (3 washes total).

steps.title: Lyse Worms and Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Lysis of the worm cuticle and RNA extraction using TRI Reagent and Zymo-Spin columns.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant and add 600μl of TRI Reagent (Zymo Research #R2050-1-50).
In a fume hood or BSC, use a motorized pestle with 1-2 sec pulses for 60 sec to break the cuticle; verify lysis via microscope.
Add 700μl of 95% ethanol and mix by gentle pipetting.
Transfer sample to a Zymo-Spin IICR Column in a Collection Tube and centrifuge at 16000 x g, 4 °C, for 1 minute.
Discard flow-through.
Optional: Add 500μl of RNA wash buffer (Zymo Research #R1003-3-24), centrifuge at 16000 x g, 4 °C, for 1 minute, and discard flow-through.

steps.title: On-Column DNA Digestion
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from the RNA sample while it is bound to the column.

substeps.instruction: Combine 5μl DNase I (6 U/μl) with 75μl DNA Digestion Buffer and mix by inversion.
Add the 80μl solution directly to the column matrix and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Add 400μl of Direct-zol RNA PreWash buffer, centrifuge at 16000 x g, 4 °C, for 1 minute, and discard flow-through.
Repeat the PreWash step once more.

steps.title: Final RNA Wash and Elution
steps.instruction: Clean the RNA and elute it into a sterile tube.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Add 700μl of RNA wash buffer (Zymo Research #R1003-3-24), centrifuge at 16000 x g, 4 °C, for 1 minute.
Transfer the column to a new RNase-free tube.
Add 50μl of DNase/RNase-Free Water (Zymo Research #W1001-1) directly to the matrix and incubate for 2-5 min.
Centrifuge at 16000 x g, 4 °C, for 1 minute to elute RNA.
Store sample on ice or at -80°C.

steps.title: RNA Quality Control
steps.instruction: Quantify RNA using NanoDrop and Qubit to ensure it meets QC criteria (Min 125 ng/μl, A260/A280 ≥ 2.0, A260/A230 2.0-2.3).

substeps.instruction: Calibrate NanoDrop with 2μl DI Water and blank with 2μl DNase/RNase-Free Water; measure 2μl of sample.
Prepare Qubit 1X dsRNA HS working solution (1:200 dilution of reagent in buffer).
Prepare two standards (190μl working solution + 10μl standard) and one sample (199μl working solution + 1μl sample).
Vortex for 5 sec, centrifuge, and incubate at room temperature for 2 min.
Run standards and sample on Qubit and record concentration.

steps.title: Prepare Sequencing Hardware
steps.instruction: Set up the MinION Mk1C and flow cell.

substeps.instruction: Power on Mk1C and insert MinION RNA flow cell (FLO-MIN004RA).
Thaw flow cell to room temperature.
Perform flow cell check; ensure at least 800 active pores.

steps.title: Prepare Library Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare all necessary buffers and adapters on ice.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1x NEBNext Quick Ligation Reaction Buffer and T4 DNA Ligase per manufacturer instructions.
Spin down and mix RT Adapter (RTA), RNA CS (RCS), and RNA Ligation Adapter (RLA).
Thaw Wash Buffer (WSB) and RNA Elution Buffer (REB) at room temperature, vortex, spin down, and place on ice.
Thaw Direct RNA sequencing (SQK-RNA004/SQK-RNA002) library reagents.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Convert RNA to cDNA using Induro Reverse Transcriptase.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1ug of RNA in 8μl of DNase/RNase-Free Water in a PCR tube; mix and spin down.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare RT Master Mix (RTMM) in a 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube: 13μl Nuclease-Free Water, 2μl 10 mM dNTPs, 8μl 5x Induro RT Reaction Buffer (Total 23μl).
Transfer RTMM to the RNA PCR tube and mix.
Add 2μl of Induro Reverse Transcriptase and mix.
Incubate in thermal cycler: 60 °C for 30 min, then 70 °C for 10 min, then cool to 4 °C.
Transfer sample to a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: First Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the reverse transcription reaction using Agencourt RNAClean XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads and add 72 µl to the reaction; mix by pipetting.
Incubate on Hula mixer for 5 min at room temperature.
Pellet on magnet and remove supernatant when clear.
Wash beads with 150 µl of 70% ethanol by rotating the tube 180° twice on the magnetic rack.
Remove ethanol and pellet on magnet until clear.
Resuspend pellet in 23 µl DNase/RNase-Free Water and incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Pellet beads on magnet and retain 23 µl of eluate in a clean 5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate adapters to the RT-RNA sample.

substeps.instruction: In a 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube, combine: 23μl RT-RNA Sample, 8μl NEBNEXT Quick Ligation Reaction Buffer, 6μl RNA Ligation Adapter (RLA), and 3μl T4 DNA Ligase (Total 40μl).
Mix by pipetting and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the ligated library using Agencourt RNAClean XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads and add 16 µl to the reaction; mix by pipetting.
Incubate on Hula mixer for 5 min at room temperature.
Pellet on magnet for 5 min and remove supernatant.
Wash beads with 150 μl Wash Buffer (WSB) by flicking to resuspend, pelleting for 5 min, and removing supernatant. Repeat wash once.
Remove remaining WSB via magnetic pelleting.
Resuspend pellet in 13 µl RNA Elution Buffer (REB) by flicking; incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Retain 13 µl of eluate in a clean 5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Flow Cell Priming
steps.instruction: Prime the MinION flow cell before loading the library.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Sequencing Buffer (SB), Library Solution (LIS), RNA Flush Tether (RFT), and Flow Cell Flush (FCF); vortex and spin down.
Prepare flow cell priming mix in a 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Slide flow cell under the Mk1C clip and open the priming port.
Remove air bubbles by drawing back 20-30 µl using a P1000 (dial set to 220-230 µl).
Load 800 µl of priming mix into the priming port and wait 5 min.
Load an additional 200 µl of priming mix into the priming port.

steps.title: Library Loading
steps.instruction: Load the prepared RNA library into the flow cell.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the library for loading in a 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube (mixing reagents as specified in the original protocol's missing table/list, though the final step is to mix gently).
Lift the SpotON sample port cover.
Add 75 μl of the prepared library to the SpotON sample port dropwise.
Close the SpotON and priming port covers.
Place the light shield over the flow cell, ensuring the leading edge is against the clip.

steps.title: Sequencing Run
steps.instruction: Configure and start the sequencing run on the Mk1C.

substeps.instruction: Click 'Start Sequencing' on the Mk1C.
Enter experiment details (name, flow cell position, sample ID).
Select 'Direct RNA Sequencing Kit (ONT SQK-RNA004)' and 'super-accurate' base-calling.
Click 'Start' to begin the run (duration 1-3 days).

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Process the sequencing data using EPI2ME and NCBI reference genomes.

substeps.instruction: Concatenate fastq files on Linux or Mac.
Run the concatenated file through the wf-transcriptomes workflow in EPI2ME.
Download C. elegans reference genome (FASTA), annotation (GFF), and transcripts (FASTA) from NCBI (RefSeq version with green check-mark).
In EPI2ME Cloud, launch the workflow using the downloaded NCBI files and the fastq_pass files, setting 'direct RNA' to True.
Optional: Perform differential expression analysis via DESeq2 or functional enrichment via GOseq and KOBAS 2.0 in R Studio.
